findings.rationale: A deeply nested JSON document, such as many '[' characters, makes json.load raise RecursionError. That is not a ValueError or an OSError, so it escapes as a raw RecursionError instead of the documented RefundRatesError. Callers that only handle RefundRatesError will crash on such a file. Catch RecursionError as well and wrap it in RefundRatesError, and add a test for deeply nested content.

`json.load` keeps only the last value when a key appears more than once. A rates file with a duplicated reason, such as two "late" entries, loads without error, and one rate is silently dropped. That kind of edit mistake is exactly what this validator should catch. Pass an `object_pairs_hook` that raises `RefundRatesError` on duplicate keys, and add a test for it.
